/ The Chapter of Fasting, for 25 it engenders a Host of Angels. /
For the Manichaeans the human body and its digestive processes worked in a very literal way so as to purify the divine light, and thus to discard the evil waste matter. Consequently, as Augustine comments, they believed that they 'breathed forth angels (Conf. III.18, IV.1)'.
